description: Skill 71 mandatory stage contract. scripts/stage_gate.py is the only enforcer: no stage starts until check exits 0, no stage closes until close exits 0. Stage IDs are canonical; a run order or prompt cannot remove or rename them. Mockup architecture (Update Plan Item 5, Decision 2 option (i)): visual-mockup is an internal layout-proof stage and is never the client-facing mockup; final-mockups is the single client-judged mockup stage, opening only after the image generation chain (image-inventory-prompts, image-generation-qc, image-map-upload) has closed.

graphics_autofails.name: garbled or misspelled baked text
graphics_autofails.summary: Pixel-vs-copy parity against the section's verbatim strings; read the image back (OCR) and compare.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

graphics_autofails.name: logo mutated, recolored or invented mark
graphics_autofails.summary: Compare against the client's LOGO reference; any change to the mark fails.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

graphics_autofails.name: legibility or contrast failure on key text
graphics_autofails.summary: Any key text element that cannot be read at its delivered size.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

graphics_autofails.name: anatomical artifact
graphics_autofails.summary: Fingers, limbs or face geometry that is wrong.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

graphics_autofails.name: placeholder or bracket token rendered as visible text
graphics_autofails.summary: For example [NAME], {{token}} or lorem ipsum on the image.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

graphics_autofails.name: brand palette drift
graphics_autofails.summary: Colors outside the brand file's stated tolerances.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

graphics_autofails.name: demographic default, mono-cast or skin-tone fidelity failure
graphics_autofails.summary: Melanated skin rendered gray or ashy, hair crushed to black, plastic skin, a specified hairstyle replaced, identity changed by lighting.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

graphics_autofails.name: provenance gap
graphics_autofails.summary: No generation receipt (task id) tying the pixels to the sanctioned KIE route.
graphics_autofails.effect: any hit is a FAIL regardless of average; a pass verdict may not cite one

handoff.note: The signature page's funnel handoff (update plan Item 32): intake records the Convert and Flow form's identity (name and object id), the pop behavior, and the step order (signature page, then product selection page, then order form page). A run with no form identity records the handoff as an explicit missing input with its reason, never a silent placeholder. Written by scripts/write_intake.py (--handoff-form-name/--handoff-form-id, or --handoff-missing-reason); the built page is checked against the record by scripts/validate_handoff.py at the responsive-html stage, and the funnel-completion receipt proves the pop live at ghl-install-test.

copy.note: Button handoff (update plan Item 8): the renderer-facing source for button labels and destinations is copy/public-copy.md, where each button is a Markdown link carrying the exact label and the destination; the full [CTA BUTTON: ...] / [CTA MICROCOPY: ...] marker forms live only in copy/internal-manuscript.md. gate:copy_handoff refuses to close this stage while any declared CTA fails to resolve a label and a destination from the public file. Contract: references/artifact-contracts.md, 'Copy manifest and the button handoff'.

copy_selection.note: Exactly ONE guide governs copy structure, selected by the run's intake copy_version (Amendment 6, Items 18/19). The selected guide's copy spec and emotional-quality extract are read with it. The Production and QC SOP and the Image Intelligence Guide v5 stay in reads as linked documents; they govern their own layers and do not override the selected guide on copy structure. The copy stage receipt records the selection as copy_selection {copy_version, guide, spec, emotional_quality} (documented in references/artifact-contracts.md).

visual-mockup.purpose: Internal layout proof and page visual bible. This stage applies the visual system to the passed wireframes and produces page-visual-bible.json (the style input the prompt stage requires) plus a layout proof render whose image slots are solid blocks by design. The layout proof is an internal production artifact: it is never presented to the client as the mockup and is never the client-judged mockup. The single client-judged mockup is final-mockups, after image generation.

design-board.purpose: The Design Board (Official Visual Direction): one board per page role the funnel has, in the client's own brand colors, carrying the client's logo and the page's ACTUAL section images. It sits after the image chain has closed (image-map-upload: every image slot has its generated or supplied file) and before final-mockups, so it shows the real images and never an art-direction stand-in. The client approves it first; the approval is recorded in design-board/production-record.json bound to the board's hash, the image set (every slot, file and file hash, re-derived from the run's own artifacts at every check) and the palette, and the final-mockups stage and everything after it for the page does not start without it (references/design-board.md; scripts/design_board.py gate). A remade board or any changed image needs a fresh approval.
reads: desktop-wireframe/image-inventory.json, desktop-wireframe/section-plan.json, image-map-upload/image-map.json and image-generation-qc/ (the page's actual images)

final-mockups.purpose: The mockup: the single client-judged mockup stage (Update Plan Items 5 and 15): the mockup carries real photography in every slot, and the stage cannot close with a placeholder slot. It opens only after the image generation chain has closed (depends_on image-map-upload) and finalizes the layout proof per section with real photography composited into every slot. Supplied assets are placed as files and never generated; the supplied-asset record is the placement proof. Every image slot must trace, through the stage's section generation record (final-mockups/generation-record.json), to a generated image file or to a placed supplied asset under Item 3's supplied-asset record; any slot tracing to neither fails the close by name (trait M1), enforced by scripts/validate_mockup_slots.py. Mockup traits bind at this stage only; the visual-mockup layout proof's solid-block slots are by design and are never scored here. At close the stage also produces the hybrid board (Update Plan Item 12): one sheet carrying the mockup-fidelity desktop panel, the section guide column, and the mockup-fidelity mobile panel, composed deterministically from the approved artifacts. The board is the artifact the stage's approval is recorded against.

responsive-html.purpose: Build the live page to match the approved final mockup, which is the design source of truth for this stage (Update Plan Item 16; Trevor's standing rule of 2026-10-11: the image is the design source of truth, the HTML is built to match it). Close requires the parity evidence: the side-by-side parity sheets at 1440 and 390 (mockup render against built page render, scripts/compare_sheet.py) and the structural drift table in responsive-html/compare/compare-report.json with drift status 'pass' (section count, section order, per-section image-placement class, heading-to-body size ratios within tolerance). Named drift failures block close; scripts/stage_gate.py enforces the evidence at close (check_parity_evidence).
